name: M2A2 - Bradley - IFV
description: An infantry fighting vehicle developed by the United States, it is named after the American five-star general Bradley. The Bradley fighting vehicle is a tracked, medium-sized combat armored vehicle that can operate independently or in conjunction with tanks. Its main weapon is a 25mm machine gun and a parallel machine gun in the turret. The Bradley fighting vehicle has appeared twice on the battlefield in Iraq and shown its talents, making great contributions to the US military.
